title: Media Buy Issue
description: Seller-owned report lifecycle, separate from transport task status and MediaBuy revision. Only the seller may acknowledge or resolve it. Reports never change delivery controls or accepted commercial terms.

status.description: reported is an automated receipt only. acknowledged means a person has taken responsibility. resolved means that person or their team recorded a terminal resolution. A seller may resolve immediately only if it also records human acknowledgement.

revision.description: Monotonically increasing issue-local revision. A stale read must not overwrite a newer snapshot.

acknowledged_at.description: Time of human acknowledgement, never an automated receipt.

resolution.description: Buyer-safe resolution summary. Resolution may explain why no seller action was warranted; it does not prove the buyer agreed or waive a dispute.

sla.description: Resolved commitment snapshotted at receipt. Required on critical reports when the matching available action declares an SLA. Warnings carry no critical-response commitment.

response_due_at.description: received_at plus sla.response_max. Frozen at receipt.

completion_due_at.description: received_at plus sla.completion_max. Frozen at receipt.

verifier_constraints.issue_scope: All identifiers belong to the requested account and media buy. The caller is authorized for that media buy. If both package_id and creative_id are supplied, the creative was associated with that package at the reported incident; removed associations remain reportable.
verifier_constraints.lifecycle: received_at <= acknowledged_at <= resolved_at when present; transitions are reported -> acknowledged -> resolved or reported -> resolved with human acknowledgement; identity, report content, received_at, sla, and deadlines are immutable; revisions increase on state changes.
verifier_constraints.deadlines: Deadlines exactly equal received_at plus the corresponding elapsed duration. Queue acknowledgement is never human acknowledgement. The declared critical response commitment is not weakened at receipt.
